item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-05-16
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 社区今天整体较平静，主要亮点是 janx 发布了一款名为 CKBadger 的本地优先 CKB 原生浏览器，作为"氛围编程"实验项目 [S01]。此外，InkHaven 团队宣布其 Scryve 平台即将在几天内从测试网切换到主网 [S05]。 ## 重点话题 **CKBadger 浏览器亮相**：janx 开源了 CKBadger，这是一个高度个人化的本地优先 CKB 原生浏览器，已开发数月，提供 GitHub 仓库、文档和在线演示 [S01]。社区成员 phroi 表示两个月前曾向他人提及类似想法，没想到 janx 已在实践 [S02]；joshyates1980 则直接称赞"简直惊人" [S03]。 **Scryve 主网即将上线**：InkHaven 确认 Scryve 目前处于测试网阶段，预计几天内切换至主网，届时将在 Nervos Talk 正式公告 [S05]。该团队昨日还开源了 `@scryve-tools` 开发工具集，涵盖钱包认证、见证编码、xUDT 金额处理等 CKB 开发常见痛点 [S06]。 **DAO 金库讨论持续推进**：phroi 在 DAO 金库预 RFC 讨论串中分享了 TeamCKB 开发日志，提及 DAO 绑定投票与链下状态等设计方向仍在积极讨论中 [S04]。 **翻译插件出现格式问题**：phroi 反馈 Babel Reunited 翻译插件在 DAO 分类的公测中出现翻译格式错误，从首版到当前版本均存在，尝试多次未能解决 [S07]。 ## 值得继续跟进 Scryve 主网实际切换时间及首批用户反馈...

item.title: CKBadger: a local-first CKB-native explorer, and a vibe-coding experiment (3 posts)
item.description: I’d like to introduce CKBadger, a local-first CKB-native explorer. It’s a small homebrew project that I’ve been working on for months. Github and Docs | Demo CKBadger is highly opinionated and not meant to be for everyone. It’s built around a few questions that I wanted to explore. Why I built it CKBadger started from several personal interests. I wanted to know how far “100% vibe coding” can go today. By that I mean: only talking to AI agents, not hand-writing code myself, and not doing code review. What kind of project can this approach actually produce? I wanted to understand what role a human should, and can, play in such a project. If AI agents can write most of the code, what is...

item.title: Pre-RFC Discussion: Activating the Nervos DAO Treasury (1 posts)
item.description: For anyone else who missed it: TeamCKB Dev Log (Updated: Apr 29, 2026) CKB DAO Treasury Design & Voting Research research on the CKB DAO Treasury design and voting settlement, with multiple directions under active discussion: Option 1: DAO-Bound Voting with Off-Chain State Explores a governance model where voting power is bound to Nervos DAO deposits, while proposal state, voting records, and tally data are maintained off-chain and committed on-chain through verifiable state roots. item.title: InkHaven: A CKB-Native Publishing Platform Built for Global Writers (1 posts)
item.description: Scryve is very much alive! It’s currently on testnet, but we expect to flip the switch to mainnet in just a few days, so stay tuned. It will be announced here on Nervos Talk as soon as it’s live. As with any project, it will be a work in progress for the foreseeable months ahead. There are many challenges along the way, but with people like you rallying behind this kickstart, we expect a very bright future. Comments like yours are exactly what keep us going, thank you for the support!

item.title: [Open Source] @scryve-tools - CKB developer utilities (1 posts)
item.description: Hello everyone, its been a while, We’ve been busy building Scryve for the past 6 months and ran into the same low-level plumbing problems most CKB developers face, wallet auth flows, witness encoding, xUDT amounts, Spore NFT DNA, payment splitting. We solved them, tested them, and now we’re making them available to everyone.
